newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: ESSO SLOVAKIA TO SUPPLY OIL TO BRATISLAVA AIRPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESSO SLOVAKIA TO SUPPLY OIL TO BRATISLAVA AIRPORT.

text.p: ESSO Slovakia s.r.o., a wholly -owned subsidiary of ESSO AG Hamburg, on Friday said it had signed contract to become the sole supplier of aircraft fuel for Bratislava airport.
ESSO Deputy Director Ratibor Lengyel told Reuters the company has also won a tender to complete construction of the airport's fuel storage facilities and to operate the tanks in the next five years.
"We have so far invested about $1 million in completion of the storage facilities, but the project will require further investment of around 10 million crowns ($330,000)," he said.
"Under the contract, ESSO Slovakia will operate the storage facilities for the next five years," he added. He declined to comment on the estimated volume of fuel supplies.
The main supplier of aircraft petrol for ESSO Slovakia will remain the Slovak refinery Slovnaft.
Lengyel said Bratislava had been one of the few remaining "interesting" European airports that had yet to sign a fuel delivery agreement with a large supplier.
"We, together with the airport authorities, hope that the guaranteed standard of our deliveries will boost interest in Bratislava among larger airline operators."
